record.question: The three files { {genes.tsv},{matrix.mtx},{barcodes.tsv} } are the 10X Genomics single-cell transcriptome dataset of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC). This dataset contains 2,700 single cells. Please preprocess the dataset, filter and select the cells, normalize the data, then use Seurat to cluster the cells, visualize the clustering data using UMAP nonlinear dimensionality reduction, obtain the differentially expressed genes for each cluster, and then use SingleR to automate the annotation of the clustering results based on the cell clustering results to obtain cell type labels for each cluster, and visualize the cell annotation types.
